predicate_definitions.OnSeabed(o): object visibly supported by / in contact with the seabed surface; false when a clear water gap exists; undecidable when the contact region is clipped/occluded or the gap is below image resolution
predicate_definitions.InGripper(o): object visibly held between closed jaws; false when jaws are open and object is outside/not enclosed; undecidable when closure state cannot be read
predicate_definitions.Lifted(o): object visibly supported above the seabed with clearance; false when on/near the seabed; undecidable when clearance cannot be resolved
predicate_definitions.NextTo(robot,o): robot end effector/body within interaction distance of the object (natural proximity reading); undecidable when the object is not visible
